test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 12 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): OQN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c3a9aef7328467b6fb371d5e1cfbd333bcc9d2d50b212cc5b90dbe435121881.png] 

**Option (2): HJG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f20861c4de60249f31f5d37d0d41c25e3dc727d22d9934c589fdb4d511a1b1c.png] 

**Option (3): YXV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8f1ce049bfbe1bbd80c0a3a3d2bd350b0145e544913a427bd2853a6b5f63ea.png] 

**Option (4): MOL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/792f58697dc78fa5e4c4673f1452e3e5db8f182fa921d4b4b131aaef4f71a577.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: **YXV**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
